nights.title: Elmiene
nights.name: Elmiene
nights.extract: Abdala Elamin, known professionally as Elmiene, is a British-Sudanese singer from Oxford. He placed fifth in the BBC Sound of 2024 poll and was nominated for the Brit Award for Rising Star in 2025.

en.who: Elmiene is the professional name of Abdala Elamin, a British-Sudanese singer from Oxford. He placed fifth in the BBC Sound of 2024 poll. He was nominated for the Brit Award for Rising Star in 2025.

de.who: Elmiene ist das Künstlerpseudonym von Abdala Elamin, einem britisch-sudanesischen Sänger aus Oxford. Er belegte beim BBC Sound of 2024 den fünften Platz. 2025 war er für den Brit Award in der Kategorie Rising Star nominiert.
facts: Beim BBC Sound of 2024 belegte er den fünften Platz.

tr.who: Elmiene, Abdala Elamin'in sahne adıdır. Oxford'dan britanyalı-sudanlı bir şarkıcıdır. BBC Sound of 2024 anketinde beşinci sırada yer aldı ve 2025'te Brit Award'da Rising Star kategorisinde aday gösterildi.
